# secopsctl

> Open-source MCP server, CLI, and Go SDK for Google SecOps (Chronicle SIEM +
> Siemplify SOAR). Give AI agents access to 360+ SecOps commands via Model
> Context Protocol, or operate your tenant as code from the terminal.

- [Home](https://secops.danny.vn/#/): Open-source MCP server, CLI, and Go SDK for Google SecOps (Chronicle SIEM + Siemplify SOAR). One tool, three interfaces — operate your...

## Getting started

- [MCP server](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/mcp): Use secopsctl as a [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server to give AI agents — Claude Code, Claude Desktop,...
- [Install](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/install): Get the secopsctl binary onto a machine, then verify it can reach your tenant. secopsctl is a single Go binary (module danny.vn/secops);...
- [Configure & auth](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/configure): One config file, two auth planes. Get both right and every other command just works.
- [The loop](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/the-loop): Detection-as-code: live state is mirrored to files under git, reviewed in a diff, and pushed back. The git history is the source of truth...

## Commands

- [Rules](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/rules): YARA-L detection rules as code: pull live rules to files, edit the .yaral text in git, push the change back. Inspect detections, errors,...
- [Search](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/search): The operational read plane: search live events with no deploy attached. Reads are free — nothing on this page mutates the tenant (the one...
- [Gemini](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/gemini): Ask SecOps in plain English. The gemini group wraps the console's AI features: turn a natural-language question into a UDM query, run that...
- [SOAR cases](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/soar-cases): Per-case SOAR triage from the CLI: read a case and its alerts, then run guarded mutations (assign, tag, close, merge, …). Every mutating...
- [Triage](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/triage): The operational loop for a SOC analyst (or an LLM agent): see the queue, pick up a case, let the AI read it first, act, and feed what you...
- [Playbooks](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/playbooks): Everything playbook-shaped, in the order you actually use it: discover the building blocks, author (offline or with the API), then operate...
- [Content Hub](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/content-hub): Browse the SecOps Content Hub — the marketplace of integrations and content packs — and install or uninstall them as code. Read verbs are...
- [Reconcile surfaces](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/reconcile): Config-as-code for the many engine surfaces: snapshot live objects to files, review in git diff, push back. One redacted, diff-friendly...

## Command reference

- [Overview](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/README): Generated from the command tree — run go run ./cmd/secopsctl docs generate after changing a command. "Guarded" commands are live mutations...
- [alerts](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/alerts): Manage SIEM detection alerts: list, get, enrich, AI investigate, and guarded feedback update
- [audit](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/audit): Run audit queries against user activity logs
- [cases](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/cases): Manage SOAR cases: read (list, get) and guarded triage (assign, tag, close, ...)
- [cleanup](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/cleanup): Remove secopsctl-owned smoke-test artifacts (guarded)
- [content-hub](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/content-hub): Browse and manage Content Hub marketplace integrations and content packs
- [curated](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/curated): Browse, search, and toggle Google-managed curated rule sets
- [dashboards](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/dashboards): Manage native dashboards (charts, widgets, layout, filters)
- [data-access](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/data-access): Manage data-access RBAC: labels (tag data) and scopes (grant access)
- [data-tables](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/data-tables): Manage data tables (import rows from CSV)
- [entities](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/entities): Inspect entities: summarize alerts, prevalence, and findings-graph pivot
- [exclusions](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/exclusions): Manage rule exclusions (findings refinements) for detections
- [gemini](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/gemini): Run AI (Gemini) features: generate queries, investigate alerts, summarize cases
- [global](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/global): Top-level commands
- [info](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/info): Show the resolved instance configuration (no API call)
- [ingest](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/ingest): Manage data ingestion (feeds, forwarders, parsers, pipelines)
- [integrations](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/integrations): Manage SOAR integration instances (imperative create/delete)
- [lists](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/lists): Manage reference lists and entity watchlists
- [mcp](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/mcp): Serve secopsctl as an MCP server and register with MCP clients
- [playbooks](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/playbooks): Discover and validate SOAR playbooks
- [rules](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/rules): Manage custom detection rules (author, test, deploy, inspect)
- [search](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/search): Search the SIEM: UDM events, raw logs, stats, saved searches
- [soar](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/soar): Operate Google SecOps SOAR (Siemplify) as code (AppKey auth, no ADC)
- [status](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/status): Show read-only diagnostics: capabilities, coverage, surfaces
- [ti](https://secops.danny.vn/#/commands/ti): Browse threat intel: find IOCs, inspect Mandiant collections (read-only)

## Design

- [Architecture](https://secops.danny.vn/#/design/architecture): How secopsctl works, independent of any one surface. Product specifics live in *canonical*, *etag*)? See the [glossary](../GLOSSARY.md).
- [Surfaces](https://secops.danny.vn/#/design/surfaces): The authoritative map of which API does what, split by plane: every API family has exactly one home (plane + host + auth + version) and one...
- [Catalog (status)](https://secops.danny.vn/#/design/catalog): The source of truth for what exists and how mature it is — one status per surface, updated in the same commit that moves the surface...
- [SIEM](https://secops.danny.vn/#/design/siem): Design for the Google SecOps SIEM surface of secopsctl. SIEM splits into two planes that need different models: config is *desired state*...
- [SOAR](https://secops.danny.vn/#/design/soar): Design for the Google SecOps SOAR surface of secopsctl, ported from real operational SOAR usage. Two facts drive it:
- [CLI naming](https://secops.danny.vn/#/design/cli-naming): Phase D is a one-shot hard rename of the secopsctl command surface to a small set of self-describing top-level groups. Every command name...
- [Glossary](https://secops.danny.vn/#/GLOSSARY): Plain-language definitions of the terms used across these docs and the CLI. You do not need any of this to use secopsctl for everyday work...
- [Doc style](https://secops.danny.vn/#/STYLE): The contract every doc in docs/ follows. Keep it short; keep it true to the code.
